page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What flanks the T tubule
steps.why: The T tubule carries the electrical signal deep into the fibre, and the cisternae beside it hold the calcium that signal releases.
common_mistakes: Naming three T tubules. There is one tubule and two cisternae.
Placing the cisternae in the mitochondria.
steps.memory_tip: One tubule between two cisternae: three parts, so triad.
steps.margin_note: Say what lies on either side of the tubule.
lines: Each T tubule is flanked on either side by

steps.label: The three together
steps.why: Naming the group of three is the answer: the word triad is a count.
common_mistakes: Leaving out the word triad in the answer.
steps.memory_tip: Tubule plus two cisternae equals one triad.

lines.text: T tubule + two terminal cisternae = triad

insider_note: The most repeated two-mark question in this chapter. The word triad means three, so the answer must name three structures.
